findings.finding: Free collocation states start at one at original public Chebyshev nodes. Forced Taylor state starts at zero and updates u,u_t,u_tt using pre-interval values with correct positive log-tau decay derivatives. Full RC5 uses matching nodewise forced recurrence. H Taylor recurrence and physical thermal/current/sample-order semantics are retained; no rig-mode branch or later-rest reset.

Selected columns retain free degree p and forced degree q for every branch plus all scalar/H/residual columns. One joint QR retains cross-family likelihood terms. Features, canonical derivatives, physical endpoint projection and full chart transport use the same compact order, including ordered-tau and Q/gamma chains.

Updates stage native state and selected rows before inherited QR; root/state/count/normalizer commit only after numerical success. Late bad rows and QR exceptions preserve previous publication. Source/order, stationary input, original rate box and physical path support are enforced. This is single-owner desktop transaction behavior, not async/runtime lifetime assurance.

The prior is included once through w cost and identity precision. Original choose_fit/solve, two public starts, 60-round budget and original centres/support are imported unchanged. Stimulus truth outputs are discarded. Source, input, binary, recipe and observation hashes are checked; four unchanged selected controls and three field snapshots must match previous study exactly.

QR covariance uses the full prior and joint likelihood; direct Jacobians retain chronological state transport. Measured M1/P3 partition diagnostics apply to all arms. Analytic P2 RC envelopes are routed only to TaylorRC controls, never to collocation-free candidates. H6 remains separately reported. Failed/unresolved fits cannot qualify fit-to-fit/forecast comparisons; every solver attempt and selected diagnostic is retained.

Summary verifies raw case and source bindings, preserves attempts/statuses and direct-relative comparisons with convergence gating. Detailed per-partition transport/forecast data remain in bound raw cases; combined fit forecasts remain in compact results. Review does not claim successful full-study parity before the run completes.

Packed factors match P4: 5624/7568/11024 B. Actual ndarray enumeration counts compact root, padded native response, both projections, duplicated native projection buffer and column selectors. Row and QR scratch categories and explicit resource exclusions prevent a complete M23 memory claim.

import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
import numpy as np
from unittest.mock import patch
from experiments.rc_partition_repair_001.test_field import PartitionTests
from experiments.rc_partition_repair_001.field import Compressed,features_jacobian,transported
from experiments.foster_uncertainty_audit_001.conditional_packet import partition
PartitionTests.setUpClass()
t=PartitionTests();rng=np.random.default_rng(110206)
o=t.fixture();o[:,0]=rng.uniform(0,1,len(o));o[::13,0]=0.;o[:,1]=rng.uniform(-.24,.24,len(o));o[:,4]=rng.uniform(.0005,.002,len(o))
out=[]
try:
 for deg,forced in [(3,2),(5,2),(5,5)]:
  f=t.make(deg,forced);rows=f.update(0,o,return_rows=True)
  node_error=0.
  for j in range(3):
   expected=np.exp(-o[:,0].sum()/(f.center[j]*np.exp(f.nodes)))
   node_error=max(node_error,float(np.max(abs(f.state[j*f.n:(j+1)*f.n]-expected))))
  assert node_error<1e-13
  w=.035*(-1.)**np.arange(16);x=t.mean+t.L@w;obj=Compressed(f,t.mean,t.L)
  c,g,P,_,_=obj(w);r=rows@f.features(x);B=rows@features_jacobian(f,x)@t.L
  cost_error=abs(c-.5*(w@w+r@r));grad_error=np.max(abs(g-w-B.T@r));precision_error=np.max(abs(P-np.eye(16)-B.T@B))
  assert cost_error<1e-6 and grad_error<1e-5 and precision_error<1e-5
  a,s=partition(x);e=f.evaluate(a,s);end,D=transported(f,x)
  assert np.max(abs(e['end'][:4]-end[:4]))<1e-14
  assert abs(e['end'][10]-np.exp(end[13])*np.tanh(end[4]))<1e-14
  previous=(f.root.copy(),f.state.copy(),f.count,f.noise)
  with patch('numpy.linalg.qr',side_effect=np.linalg.LinAlgError('review fault')):
   try:f.update(f.count,o[:3])
   except np.linalg.LinAlgError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError('injected QR failure accepted')
  assert np.array_equal(f.root,previous[0]) and np.array_equal(f.state,previous[1]) and (f.count,f.noise)==previous[2:]
  invalid=0
  for col,val in [(0,-.01),(0,1.01),(1,.251),(2,24.99),(3,np.nan),(4,0),(4,np.inf)]:
   bad=o[:4].copy();bad[-1,col]=val
   try:f.update(f.count,bad)
   except ValueError:invalid+=1
   else:raise AssertionError('invalid observation accepted')
   assert np.array_equal(f.root,previous[0]) and np.array_equal(f.state,previous[1]) and (f.count,f.noise)==previous[2:]
  storage=f.storage();assert storage['retained_numpy_arrays_B']==sum(v.nbytes for v in vars(f).values() if isinstance(v,np.ndarray))
  assert set(['pu','native_projection','columns','p1','state','root']).issubset(storage['array_breakdown_B'])
  out.append(dict(free=deg,forced=forced,node_exponential_max_error=node_error,dense_cost_error=float(cost_error),dense_gradient_max_error=float(grad_error),dense_precision_max_error=float(precision_error),QR_failure_atomic=True,invalid_observation_atomic_cases=invalid,packed_factor_B=storage['packed_factor_B'],partial_numeric_B=storage['numeric_factor_response_domain_scalars_B'],retained_numpy_B=storage['retained_numpy_arrays_B']))
 print(json.dumps(dict(seed=110206,records=len(o),arms=out),indent=2))
finally:PartitionTests.tearDownClass()
